digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Two priority decisions were closed today, while tomorrow's UAT rollout still needs focused follow-through on access and a compressed meeting schedule. Seven items remain open after a day with two confirmed cancellations.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect calling-policy path
items.detail: The calling-policy decision for new offices was completed today.

items.label: Decided the attorney calling-platform treatment
items.detail: The attorney platform decision was completed ahead of the UAT kickoff sequence.

items.label: Secure the dedicated Salesforce integration account
items.detail: Confirm whether the non-human production account will be created directly or routed through Halo, including the required permissions and monitoring.

items.label: Resolve Amazon Connect UAT access issues before Tuesday's kickoffs
items.detail: Today's checkpoint surfaced Salesforce UAT, telephony, and Omni-Channel access problems. The issues were sent to the technical team, which is expected to join the Round 2 channel tomorrow.

items.label: Lock the Legal Guidance SOP and training path
items.detail: Training starts September 8 while the SOPs remain under review. Confirm that training can proceed, secure the remaining approvals, and protect the September 15 Contigo launch.

items.label: Review the executive updates deck
items.detail: Complete the requested Monday review and add the slide covering EPMO projects completed in August before Tuesday's slide block.

items.label: Confirm the Enterprise Knowledge Management project record
items.detail: Confirm whether the project record's deletion was intentional and which record should remain authoritative.

items.label: Reconcile Asana with Armando's spreadsheet
items.detail: Close stale entries and leave one current operating view before this week's portfolio reviews.

items.label: Clarify the Toggl capacity model and escalation path
items.detail: Document how capacity will be measured, who owns missing project IDs, and how the data will inform staffing.

items.label: SVC Daily Standup was canceled
items.detail: The 10:30 AM standup was explicitly canceled on today's calendar.

items.label: BD Portfolio Review was canceled
items.detail: Jean canceled this week's meeting because of the U.S. holiday.

items.label: 10:30-11:30 AM - Double-booked start, access check, and slide focus
items.detail: The Jhara 1:1 overlaps SVC Daily Standup at 10:30 AM. At 11:00 AM, the required UAT access recheck overlaps the EPMO slide focus block.

items.label: 1:00-3:00 PM - Leadership meetings collide with UAT
items.detail: CSO GLs Huddle runs 1:00-2:00 PM. EPMO TL Weekly Catch Up at 2:00 PM overlaps the 2:15 PM Group 4 UAT kickoff.

items.label: 3:00-5:45 PM - Amazon Connect kickoff sequence
items.detail: Group 2 starts at 3:00 PM and overlaps the 3:30 PM Nicolas 1:1; Groups 3 and 1 follow at 4:00 PM and 5:00 PM. Confirm coverage and clear access blockers before the sequence.
